summary:
GAME STATE SUMMARY — I am the Runner (The Catalyst), turn 12 discard phase, score 2-2 (I stole Orbital SuperSphere, Corp scored Offworld Office). I need 5 AP to win (7 points win).

MY RIG: Unity (decoder str 1), Cleaver (fracter str 3), DZMZ (+1 MU), Smartware Distributor (2 loaded), Red Team (12 loaded). 3 credits, 5 MU total/2 used. Corp has 16 credits, 5 cards in HQ.

CORP DEFENSES: HQ=2 ice (Tithe outer, +1 hidden inner), R&D=Karunā sentry str3, Archives=1 hidden ice, Remote0=2 hidden ice+besides Whitespace rezzed code gate. I can only break code gates (Unity) and barriers (Cleaver) — I have NO killer, so sentries (Tithe, Karunā) are dangerous.

KEY STRUCTURE: Turn 1-5 I built economy and stole Orbital Agent; turns 6-8 I set up breakers/economy; turns 10-12 I took 3 net damage (from Karunā and Tithe) and have been rebuilding. Current grip (after discarding Sure Gamble): Overclock, Pennyshaver, Wildcat Strike, Unity (2nd copy), Tread Darkly, Tread Darkly (2nd). I MUST DISCARD ONE MORE card (currently chosen Sure Gamble; need one more discard — recommend Unity 2nd copy or Tread Darkly since I have two).

STRATEGIC PRIORITIES:
1) Survive — I have 6 cards in grip now (about to be 5-6), need to keep grip healthy because every sentry hits net damage.
2) Press the Corp — Corp has huge economy (16c) but I can still profit via Red Team runs. HQ is risky (2 ice, 1 net dmg each); R&D has Karuna str 3 killer (can't break without killing). Best pressure target is to install the second Unity or use RemoteNode — I can break Whitespace code gate with Unity.
3. Get kills nectar: Vet future — need income from Red Team (12c stored; can take 3 per successful central run) and Smartware (2 loaded).
4. Early game I already stole twice; Corp is equally AG. I need approximately 3 agendas (typically 2-3 awards each) to win — tight.

REMEMBER: I have been too risky on runs vs sentries without a Killer. If I can't break the ice safely, JACK OUT rather than take damage. My best movesabe sheet cards: Tread Water (costs 1, +3 rez cost during run), Wildcat Strike (2x, gain 6 or draw 4), Overclock (1 activation, 5 loaded, unblocked Bonding over HQ etc).

summary:
SUMMARY — ANDROID: NETRUNNER RUNNER GAME STATE (turn 15, mid-run)

SCORE: Runner 4 AP (stole Orbital Superiority + Offworld Office), Corp 4 AP (scored Offworld Office + Orbital Superiority). First to 7 wins. I am The Catalyst (neutral Runner, no ability). Corp is The Syndicate (no ability).

CURRENT SITUATION (runner turn 15, mid-run on HQ):
- I am running HQ via Red Team's click ability. Passed Tithe outer ice (took 1 net damage — trashed my Wildcat Strike; grip now 1 card: Mutual Favor). Now encountering Diviner (code gate, strength 3, rezzed, 1 subroutine: "Do 1 net damage; if you trash a card with odd printed cost, end the run").
- I just boosted Unity to strength 3 (paid 1 credit, now 5 credits). Next decision must be to break Diviner's subroutine with Unity (1 credit) — DO IT to protect my last grip card.
- After this, I breach HQ: access 1 random card from Corp's 5-card HQ hand. Red Team pays 3 credits on successful run (Red Team has 3 credits loaded; after this it is empty and trashes). Pennyshaver gains 1 credit on successful run.

MY RIG:
- Programs: Unity (decoder, str 1, 1 MU), Cleaver (fracter, str 3, 1 MU) — memory 2/6 used (DZMZ +1 MU, Pennyshaver +1 MU)
- Hardware: DZMZ Optimizer (no counters), Pennyshaver console (0 credits currently; +1 MU; action: place 1c then take all)
- Resources: Smartware Distributor (empty/no counters — it gains 1 credit at start of my turn automatically, wait it actually: "When your turn begins, take 1 credit from this resource" — it has no stored credits and no [click]: place 3 ability result shown; if empty it's about to be used? Actually Smartware Distributor: [click]: place 3 credits; when turn begins take 1. It currently has 0 stored, so at my next turn start I take nothing and it's effectively empty but stays installed), Red Team (3 credits loaded; after this run will be empty and trash)
- Credits: 5 (after paying to break Diviner: 4)
- Grip: 1 card (Mutual Favor — search stack for icebreaker, reveal; if I made a successful run this turn may install it free; else add to grip). I DID make a successful Archives run + HQ run earlier this turn, so Mutual Favor can install an icebreaker for free if I play it.
- Clicks: 3 remaining (after this run resolves; Red Team run cost 1 click already)
- Stack: 13 cards; Heap: many trashed cards
- No tags, no core damage, no bad publicity. Link 0.

CORP STATE:
- Credits: 3-4 (was 3 before Tithe's "Gain 1c" fired; now ~4)
- HQ: 5 cards (I just stole Offworld Office from it earlier this turn — it had Retribution before, now 5 cards after draws)
- R&D: 18 cards. Archives: ~9 cards (only trashed ops/assets, no agendas available there)
- Scored: Offworld Office (2 AP), Orbital Superiority (2 AP)
- Servers:
  - HQ: Tithe (sentry, str 1, rezzed: sub1 = 1 net dmg, sub2 = Corp gains 1c) + Diviner (code gate, str 3, rezzed: 1 sub = 1 net dmg, odd-cost trash ends run)
  - R&D: Karunā (sentry, str 3, rezzed: sub1 = 2 net dmg + Runner may jack out, sub2 = 2 net dmg) — CANNOT run R&D safely: 2 net damage with my low grip = flatline risk. If grip ≥3 the first sub is survivable but second requires jacking out after first.
  - Archives: 1 unrezzed ice (Corp couldn't rez it at 0 credits earlier; Corp now has ~4 credits, could rez). Archives has NO agendas — only trashed cards, not worth running.
  - Remote 0: 3 rezzed ice — Diviner (code gate str 3) outer, Brân 1.0 (barrier bioroid str 6, subs: install ice inward / end run / end run; Runner can lose clicks to break its subs), Whitespace (code gate str 0, subs: Runner loses 3c / if Runner ≤6c end run). Root: 1 hidden card installed turn 14 by Corp (could be an agenda or asset; Corp advanced something then scored Orbital Superiority from it — the root card is a NEW installation, mysterious; high priority to check but the 3-ice wall is expensive: Unity breaks Diviner (2c), Brân requires 3 clicks or Cleaver boost to str 6 (too expensive at 2c/+1 = 6c), Whitespace breakable by Unity (2c). Too costly to get through this turn.)

WHAT HAPPENED RECENTLY: Turn 13 I ran Remote 0 with Tread Lightly (razed Diviner 5c, Brân 9c — Corp bankrupted to 0c but ended my run via Brân). Then Red Team ran Archives successfully (unrezzed ice, +3c, accessed all Archive trash). Turn 14: Corp scored Orbital Superiority (Seamless Launch + advances) giving me a tag; I removed the tag, then Red Team ran HQ to steal Offworld Office (4-4 tie!). Corp installed a new card in Remote 0 root. Turn 15: Corp drew 2 + gained 2 (now ~4c). I used Red Team on HQ again — taking Tithe damage, now on Diviner.

KEY STRATEGIC PRIORITIES:
1. Immediately break Diviner's subroutine (1 credit) then breach HQ, access 1 of 5 cards — big steal chance. Red Team will pay 3c and then empty/trash. Then I keep 3 clicks (after run).
2. After the run, my grip will be 1 (Mutual Favor). Play Mutual Favor (free, cost 0) to search for an icebreaker — since I made a successful run this turn, I can install it for free. This is the best next action: gets me a killer (Carmen) to handle sentries (Tithe, Karunā, Tithe is killable with Carmen; Karunā str 3 breakable by Carmen at 2 boost steps = 4c + 1c/sub). Cards in deck: 2x Carmen (killer), 2x Unity (decoder), 2x Cleaver (fracter), 2x Mayfly (AI). I already have Unity + Cleaver installed, so fetch Carmen to handle the sentry threat.
3. Protect grip constantly — every run vs sentries costs net damage. Never run R&D while grip ≤2 (Karunā = 2 net dmg ×2 = flatline).
4. Alternative after run: install Pennyshaver credit or draw cards to rebuild. But Mutual Favor → Carmen is high value.
5. Win condition: need 3 more AP. Corp is also at 4. Pressure HQ (Tithe+Diviner, both rezzed) is breakable: take Tithe's 1 net dmg (or kill with Carmen if installed) + break Diviner with Unity. R&D is blocked by Karunā until I have Carmen. Remote 0's hidden root card may be an agenda — if it's still there next turns, that wall is very expensive (Brân needs 3 click-loses or 6c Cleaver boost). Might consider Mutuel Favor fetching something cheap and playing Tread Lightly to make rezzing expensive.
6. Corp at low credits (~4) — they can rez cheap ice but not expensive ones. Use this window to pressure HQ repeatedly.

CARDS LEFT IN MY STACK (13): remaining Unknown — likely 1 Cleaver, 1-2 Unity, 1-2 Carmen, 2 Mayfly, 1 Leech, 1 Conduit, 1-2 Overclock, 1-2 VRcation, 1 Sure Gamble, 1-2 Jailbreak, 1-2 Tread Lightly, etc.

SPECIFIC FORTHCOMING DECISIONS:
- Break Diviner (option "Break 1 code gate subroutine" Unity) — pay 1c, then move to breach HQ.
- After breach: use Mutual Favor to grab Carmen (free install) — best next play if I want to kill sentries. Also could draw/VRcation to rebuild grip (grip=1 is flirting with flatline).
- If I had 3 clicks after the run: mutual favor (+ install), then maybe a basic run on HQ with clicks if affordable (Tithe dmg + Diviner break costs ~3c) — but grip risk. Prefer rebuilding.

REMEMBER RULES: Net damage trashes X random cards from grip; flatline if damage exceeds grip. Scores: 7 to win, currently 4-4. Red Team action requires a central server I haven't run this turn (HQ run used it; after this, Red Team's runs done — can't use again this turn). Pennyshaver (console, limit 1 per player) stores credits. DZMZ first program each turn costs 1 less. Wildcat Strike (Corp chooses): gain 6c or draw 4. Tread Lightly: +3 rez cost during run. Overclock: 5 hosted credits for a run.

summary:
# ANDROID: NETRUNNER GAME STATE SUMMARY (runner turn 16, late mid-run on HQ)

## SCORE: Corp 5 AP, Runner 4 AP. First to 7 wins.

## CURRENT IMMEDIATE SITUATION
- I am mid-run on HQ (basic action run, my last click of turn 16 was spent initiating it).
- Tithe (outer, sentry str 1) — I broke its "Do 1 net damage" sub with Carmen; its "Gain 1c" sub resolved (Corp gained 1 credit).
- Diviner (inner, code gate str 3) — I boosted Unity +3 (now strength 4) and broke its damage subroutine.
- I am now in Movement Phase after passing all HQ ice, with options "continue" or "jack out". I MUST choose **continue** (option 0) to breach HQ and access 1 card from Corp's 7-card hand. This is my best agenda-steal opportunity.
- After this breach resolves, my turn will end (clicks already 0). Then Corp turn comes.
- Credits: 1. Grip: 1 card (Verbal Plasticity). Pennyshaver has 1 credit on it.

## MY RIG (installed)
- **Programs (memory 3/6 used):** Unity (decoder, base str 1; boost 1c = +3 per installed icebreaker, now 3 breakers installed), Cleaver (fracter, str 3), Carmen (killer, str 2; 1c breaks 1 sentry sub; installed free this turn via Mutual Favor)
- **Hardware:** DZMZ Optimizer (+1 MU), Pennyshaver console (+1 MU, stores credits)
- **Resources:** Smartware Distributor (no counters; [click]: place 3c; at turn start take 1c — I've been cashing it)
- **Trashed/discarded:** Red Team is trashed (it emptied itself when it paid 3c on its last successful run). No other key rig losses — I replaced Unity but have Unity still installed (the one trashed earlier by damage was an extra? Actually my Unity in rig got trashed by Tithe damage on turn 13, and I still have one. Wait, in current rig I have Unity installed — the copy that was trashed was from damage but I must have had another? Actually the state shows Unity installed at strength 1 base, so it's fine.)
- Credits: 1. Grip: Verbal Plasticity. No tags, no core damage, link 0.

## CORP STATE
- **Scored (5 AP):** Offworld Office (2), Orbital Superiority (2), Superconducting Hub (1). Their hand max size is 7 due to Superconducting Hub.
- **HQ:** 7 cards (I keep accessing Retribution and Palisade from it, no agendas found on last several runs).
- **R&D:** 15 cards. **Archives:** ~10 cards including a facedown hidden card (Corp discarded at end of a turn). No agendas known in Archives.
- **Credits:** 3 (Corp has been poor, ~1-3 credits). Corp's Remote 0 root is now EMPTY (they scored Superconducting Hub from it). All HQ ice is rezzed now: Tithe (str 1) + Diviner (str 3).
- **Corp ice elsewhere:** Karunā on R&D (sentry str 3, 2 net damage ×2 subs) — unbroken, dangerous. Archives has 1 unrezzed ice. Remote 0 still has Diviner/Brân/Whitespace all rezzed but no root card (not worth running).
- **Corp hand may contain:** Send a Message (3 AP), more Offworld Office/Orbital Superiority, assets, operations. HQ is my main access point for steals.

## RECENT HISTORY
- I stole Orbital Superiority (turn 13-ish) and Offworld Office (turn 14) to reach 4 AP.
- Corp scored Orbital Superiority (gave me a tag, I removed it) and Superconducting Hub (turn 16).
- I've been repeatedly running HQ (Tithe + Diviner wall). Tithe damage is now breakable with Carmen. I installed Carmen for free via Mutual Favor this turn after a successful run.
- Corp's HQ runs have accessed: Retribution (twice), Palisade — no agenda steals yet on turns 15-16.

## KEY STRATEGY
1. **Keep stealing from HQ.** It's my only reliable agenda source — Corp scores from remotes but HQ holds agendas. My breaker set (Unity + Carmen + Cleaver) fully handles HQ's Tithe/Diviner at ~3-4 credits per run.
2. **Protect grip at all costs.** I run with 1 card constantly. Always break damage subroutines (Tithe 1 net dmg, Diviner 1 net dmg + odd-cost end check). Never run R&D (Karunā = 2 net dmg, flatline risk with ≤2 grip).
3. **Economy:** Pennyshaver stores credits on successful runs; cash it ([click]: place 1, then take all) whenever I need money. Smartware Distributor generates 1c/turn at start. Corp is credit-starved (~3c) — exploit by pressuring HQ.
4. **Win condition:** need 3 more AP. Corp at 5 — whoever steals/scored next wins. HQ is my best shot; continue accessing it every turn.

## IMMEDIATE NEXT ACTIONS
1. **Choose option 0 (continue)** to breach HQ and access 1 card. Given 7 HQ cards and Corp's deck composition, good odds of an agenda (they hold Send a Message, Offworld, Orbital, Hubs).
2. If I steal, score goes 6-5 (or higher); then Corp turn — watch for them scoring from a new remote (they can install+advance quickly with Seamless Launch).
3. Next runner turn: rebuild grip (draw/VRcation), cash Pennyshaver, keep running HQ.

## RULES REMINDERS
- Net damage trashes X random grip cards; flatline if damage > grip count (which is why 1-card grip runs require breaking all damage subs).
- Unity boost: 1c gives +X strength where X = number of installed icebreakers (currently 3, so +3 per credit).
- Carmen: 1c breaks 1 sentry subroutine (no strength boost needed for Tithe str 1 since Carmen base 2).
- Corp hand is HQ; accessing HQ accesses 1 random card.
